definitions.explanation: To receive something that is given, sent, or directed toward you. Often used for abstract things like impressions, influence, or damage.
To undergo or sit for an exam, test, interview, or medical examination.

definitions.gloss: to be popular, to be well-received (colloquial)
definitions.explanation: In casual speech, to be funny or successful with an audience. Often used as ウケる in katakana.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{受|う}けます。
examples.english: I will take an exam next week.
examples.notes: {試験|しけん}を{受|う}ける is the standard expression for 'take a test'

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{受|う}けた。
examples.english: He received a big influence. / He was greatly influenced.
examples.notes: {影響|えいきょう}を{受|う}ける = to be influenced

examples.notes: {被害|ひがい}を{受|う}ける = to suffer damage

examples.english: His impressions are always a hit in class.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive). Pattern: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{受|う}ける (receive/take X). No intransitive pair.

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing state or completed action with continuing relevance. {受|う}けて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ = 'is receiving/undergoing' or 'has received.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{受|う}ける (take an exam)
・⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{受|う}ける (have an interview)
・⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{受|う}ける (be influenced)
・⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{受|う}ける (suffer damage)
・⟦{印象|いんしょう}→印象：01846_inshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{受|う}ける (receive an impression)
・⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{受|う}ける (undergo surgery)

NUANCE: Unlike ⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧ (to receive from someone), {受|う}ける often implies receiving something abstract or undergoing an experience. For concrete gifts, ⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧ is more natural.

COLLOQUIAL: ウケる (often in katakana) means 'to be funny/popular.' ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ウケた = 'His story went over well.'
